about: Where things live in A1 (docs/layout.md explains each folder). tests/layout.test.js fails when a tracked file or folder sits anywhere these lists do not allow, so nothing is ever left loose. A new program gets its own folder: add it to `folders` here and to docs/layout.md in the same change.

files.index.html: TaskHub + the journals. The site root (/A1/) serves it, so it cannot move.
files.404.html: GitHub Pages' not-found page: forwards every moved page's old address.
files.firebase-messaging-sw.js: Push service worker. Its scope must cover index.html, so it sits beside it.
files.CLAUDE.md: Claude Code reads it from the repo root.
files.README.md: GitHub shows it on the repo's front page.
files.package.json: npm (test tooling) runs from the root.

folders.Backup: A1Backup: backup.js, the restore/export pages and the repo copies (Index Backups/)
folders.docs: every doc, plan and README, one subfolder per project
folders.Guardian: the one lock (guardian.js); hosts load it from this path
folders.LifeHub: the app switcher (lifehub.js); hosts load it from this path
folders.magi: MAGI: the console (magi.html) and its engine (a Python package run as `python -m magi`)
folders.Notebook: the journals and the DOCX editor
folders.PriceWatch: the Price Watch extension (Brave loads it unpacked from this folder)
folders.Rules: machine-read rules: cleanup-rules.json, firestore.rules, this file
folders.Shared: files every program loads: scrollbar, popups, controls, dragsort, resizegrip, hoverfx, apphead, profilepick, tabsync, sweep, tni, catdebrief
folders.Shield: Shield: the page (shield.html) and the desktop agent (desktop/)
folders.TaskHub: TaskHub's own scripts (its page is index.html at the root)
folders.tests: every A1 test suite (Shruti and the MAGI engine keep theirs in their own folders)
folders.tools: scripts run by hand or by a scheduled task
folders.workers: Cloudflare workers on account 1 (the folder picks the account)

files.package.json: the V1 build and its tests run from V1/

folders.StudyOS: StudyOS: studyos.html with its css, js, config, assets, vendor, manifest, service worker and desktop app
folders.TradeBoard: TradeBoard (tradeboard.html) and its desktop and sync tools
folders.Launcher: the Launcher extension (Brave loads it unpacked from this folder)
folders.firebase: Firestore rules and config for V1's Firebase project
folders.scripts: the build, tests and Push Changes

files.layout.md: where everything lives (this file's explanation); CLAUDE.md links it
